var (
    // Realm of tokens
    TokenRealm = "expiro"

    // Name of identity key in tokens
    TokenIdentityKey = "id"

    // Name of username key in tokens
    TokenUsernameKey = "username"

    // Name of authentication header in token
    TokenHeadName = "Bearer"

)
